# Navigating Market Volatility. ## Voya is here to help. ###### What goes up, must come down and the financial markets are no different. At Voya, we know when markets shift, it’s your money and it’s personal. We know you want to feel confident about your investments as you navigate market volatility. Here are some key things to keep in mind — to help keep your future in perspective. Markets are meant to move up and down. The key is to stay steady and stay invested. Be your own rock and stick to your plan no matter what is happening in the world. Looking past the headlines of today and taking a historical viewpoint can give you a sense of calm through this market storm. ## Strategies for today’s markets: How to navigate it wisely. It’s important to keep calm and think about your long-term investment strategy. Read on to understand why you should stay the course with your investments during volatile markets.
